mapper.select: -- 짧은 원장 변경만 직렬화한다. HTTP/추출은 transaction 밖에서 실행한다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(79101)::text
-- 모든 변경은 부모 run 다음 case 순서로 잠근다. SELECT id::text FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs WHERE id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
-- 잠금 순서를 결정하는 불변 관계만 읽는다. SELECT run_id FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases WHERE id=#{caseId}

-- 내부 실행 원장의 전체 분모. 외부 목록 API는 별도 pagination projection을 사용해야 한다. SELECT WHERE c.run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY c.ordinal

INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs(id,policy_id,policy_row_version,rule_release_id,rule_row_version,snapshot_hash, catalog_hash,execution_code_hash,runtime_hash,required_scope_json,expected_case_count,maximum_requests,maximum_bytes,requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash) VALUES(#{runId},#{policyId},#{policyVersion},#{ruleReleaseId},#{ruleVersion},#{snapshotHash},#{catalogHash},#{executionCodeHash},#{runtimeHash}, CAST(#{requiredScopeJson} AS jsonb),#{expectedCaseCount},#{maximumRequests},#{maximumBytes},#{requestedBy},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash})

-- 원본/URL/제목 대신 서버 고정 입력 지문만 저장한다. mapper.update: -- 부모 lock 아래 case/run 사용량을 같은 statement에서 증가시킨다. 예산을 환급하지 않는다. WITH candidate AS ( SELECT c.id,c.run_id WHERE AND ((#{requests}=1 AND #{bytes}=0) OR (#{requests}=0 AND #{bytes}>0)) AND c.request_reservations+#{requests}<=c.maximum_requests AND r.request_reservations+#{requests}<=r.maximum_requests AND c.reserved_bytes+#{bytes}<=c.maximum_bytes AND r.reserved_bytes+#{bytes}<=r.maximum_bytes AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_resource_leases l WHERE l.provider_qa_case_id=c.id AND l.provider_qa_lease_token=c.lease_token AND l.resource_code='DOWNLOAD' AND l.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_resource_leases l WHERE l.provider_qa_case_id=c.id AND l.provider_qa_lease_token=c.lease_token AND l.resource_code='HOST' AND l.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()) FOR UPDATE OF c ), changed AS ( UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases c SET request_reservations=c.request_reservations+#{requests}, reserved_bytes=c.reserved_bytes+#{bytes},row_version=c.row_version+1 FROM candidate d WHERE c.id=d.id RETURNING c.run_id ) UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs r SET request_reservations=r.request_reservations+#{requests}, reserved_bytes=r.reserved_bytes+#{bytes},row_version=r.row_version+1 WHERE r.id IN (SELECT run_id FROM changed)
mapper.insert: -- 기존 전역 slot을 공유한다. 살아 있는 job/정책 QA/Provider QA 소유자는 덮어쓰지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_resource_leases(resource_code,resource_key,slot_no,provider_qa_case_id,provider_qa_lease_token,resource_lease_token,lease_expires_at) SELECT #{resourceCode},#{resourceKey},#{slotNo},c.id,c.lease_token,#{resourceToken},clock_timestamp()+interval '40 seconds' WHERE ON CONFLICT(resource_code,resource_key,slot_no) DO UPDATE SET job_id=NULL,job_lease_token=NULL,policy_validation_id=NULL,policy_validation_lease_token=NULL, provider_qa_case_id=EXCLUDED.provider_qa_case_id,provider_qa_lease_token=EXCLUDED.provider_qa_lease_token, resource_lease_token=EXCLUDED.resource_lease_token,lease_expires_at=EXCLUDED.lease_expires_at,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE announcement_attachment_resource_leases.lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
mapper.delete: -- 같은 case/token/permit만 반환한다. 다른 owner가 만료 slot을 인수했으면 삭제하지 않는다. DELETE FROM announcement_attachment_resource_leases WHERE provider_qa_case_id=#{caseId} AND provider_qa_lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND resource_lease_token=#{resourceToken}
-- 종료 또는 실패한 실행이 아직 소유한 임대만 반환한다. DELETE FROM announcement_attachment_resource_leases WHERE provider_qa_case_id=#{caseId} AND provider_qa_lease_token=#{leaseToken}
mapper.update: -- 원본 정리 이후 live 소유 token으로만 저장한다. 취소/입력 변경은 성공보다 우선한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases c SET case_status_code=CASE WHEN r.run_status_code='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN NOT () THEN 'FAILED' ELSE #{statusCode} END, error_code=CASE WHEN r.run_status_code='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 'EXECUTION_STOPPED' WHEN NOT () THEN 'INPUT_CHANGED' ELSE #{errorCode} END, evidence_json=CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS jsonb),evidence_hash=#{evidenceHash},lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,completed_at=clock_timestamp(),row_version=c.row_version+1 FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs r,announcement_attachment_policies p,announcement_source_classification_rule_releases t WHERE c.id=#{caseId} AND c.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND c.case_status_code='RUNNING' AND c.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND r.id=c.run_id AND r.run_status_code IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND p.id=r.policy_id AND t.id=r.rule_release_id

-- 운영 예약 API에서 actor/버전 검증 후 호출할 내부 변경 계약이다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs SET run_status_code='CANCEL_REQUESTED',row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{runId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND run_status_code IN ('READY','RUNNING')

-- 이미 실행 중인 case는 자기 소유자가 정리하고 끝낸다. 미실행 분모는 취소 상태로 보존한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases c SET case_status_code='CANCELLED',error_code='EXECUTION_STOPPED',completed_at=clock_timestamp(),row_version=c.row_version+1 FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs r WHERE r.id=c.run_id AND r.id=#{runId} AND r.run_status_code='CANCEL_REQUESTED' AND c.case_status_code='PENDING'

-- 만료된 소유자의 늦은 응답은 저장하지 않는다. 재시도는 새 승인 계획에서만 가능하다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases c SET case_status_code='FAILED',error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED', lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,completed_at=clock_timestamp(),row_version=c.row_version+1 FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs r WHERE r.id=c.run_id AND r.id=#{runId} AND ((c.case_status_code='RUNNING' AND c.lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()) OR (c.case_status_code='PENDING' AND r.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()))

-- COMPLETED는 예약 case 전체 기대값 일치다. 전체 Provider/정책 VERIFIED는 별도 검증이며 여기서 변경하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_provider_qa_runs r SET run_status_code=CASE WHEN r.run_status_code='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases c WHERE c.run_id=r.id AND c.case_status_code<>'PASSED') THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, completed_at=clock_timestamp(),row_version=r.row_version+1 WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.run_status_code IN ('READY','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_provider_qa_cases c WHERE c.run_id=r.id AND c.case_status_code IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'))
